officialInventory.summary: No standalone official register was found. The most explicit official statement is Mauritania's 6th CBD national report (2019, section 7.2 'Situation des aires protégées'), which lists two national parks (Banc d'Arguin, Diawling), a recently created third park (Awleigatt), the Cap Blanc satellite reserve and the (unclassified) Chat Tboul reserve, plus several areas under study. The two main parks are public administrative establishments with their own laws/decrees and official websites (pnba.mr, pnd.mr); a Direction des aires protégées et du littoral (DAPL) exists within the environment ministry. The 'Zones protégées' page of the national CBD clearing-house (mr.chm-cbd.net) reproduces outdated WCMC-derived entries and was not used.

areas.name: Parc National du Banc d'Arguin

legalStatus.text: Governed by Loi n° 2000/024 of 19 January 2000 (defines the park as a 'réserve protégée' and its boundaries); park created in 1976 per the official website

areas.notes: 12 000 km² per pnba.mr ('délimitant son territoire à 12 000 km²'); includes maritime, insular and continental parts (law art. 3). World Heritage site and Ramsar site (handled separately).

areas.name: Réserve Satellite du Cap Blanc

legalStatus.text: Created in 1986 by Décret 86-060 (per NR6); attached to the Parc National du Banc d'Arguin by art. 4 of Loi n° 2000/024

areas.notes: Created to protect the Mediterranean monk seal (Monachus monachus).

areas.name: Parc National du Diawling

legalStatus.text: Created by Décret n° 91-005 of 14 January 1991 (public administrative establishment)

areas.notes: Decree: 'couvrira une superficie d’environ 15.600 ha'. Lower Senegal River delta, right bank (coastal zone per NR6). NR6 mentions a planned extension within the Senegal River Delta transboundary biosphere reserve. Ramsar site (handled separately).

areas.name: Parc National d'Awleigatt
areas.notes: NR6 (2019): 'un troisième parc récemment créé est celui d'Awleigatt'. Spellings vary (Aouleigatt/Aouleygatt). Creation act, date and area not located.

areas.name: Réserve de Chat Tboul
areas.notes: NR6 calls it a reserve but says it is 'non classé', managed by the national navy, and a core area of the Senegal River Delta transboundary biosphere reserve; Ramsar site since 10/11/2000. NR6 also lists 'la création d’une aire protégée au niveau du Chat TBoul' among projects, so legal protected-area status is doubtful.

areas.name: Baie de l'Étoile
areas.notes: Listed in NR6 (2019) among protected-area creation projects 'dans un état très avancé'; current status not verified.

areas.name: Guelb er Richat
areas.notes: Listed in NR6 (2019) among protected-area creation projects; current status not verified.

notEnumerated.category: sites under study / proposed protected areas (PoWPA)
notEnumerated.reason: NR6 lists further candidate sites (Mahmouda, El Agher, El Atf, Bougahri–Metrewgha, Lac de Mal, Oudhne Levrass, Tilemci, Dhar Oualata Tichitt, El Agane, Kankossa) without any legal status; not recorded individually.
No official list or count found.

gaps: No official consolidated list after 2019 was found; Mauritania had not submitted a 7th CBD national report in the CBD index at time of research.
Creation act, date and area of the Parc National d'Awleigatt were not found in FAOLEX or official sources.
PNBA's original 1976 creation decree (n° 76-147, referenced in FAOLEX/LEAP as repealed) was not fetched; the 1976 date comes from pnba.mr.
Area of the Cap Blanc satellite reserve not documented in fetched sources.
The national CBD clearing-house page 'Zones protégées' (mr.chm-cbd.net/fr/zones-protegees) reproduces old WCMC entries (e.g. 'Las Cuevecillas', 'Réserve du Mouflon') of unclear validity; not used.
